text:
Maya: Quick idea 1: create a tiny one-liner deploy shorthand for runbooks (expands to pins, canary, window, preflight, rollback-policy). Tired of long pasted examples.
Sam: Love it. Call it `deployx` or `run-deploy`? small CLI that expands server-side.
Lina: Server-side expansion + linting sounds necessary (so we enforce pin rules).
Jorge: Compliance: require `pin-reason` when pin duration >24h for enterprise customers. Bot should block otherwise.
Maya: Sketch syntax: 
```
run-deploy payments@sha:abcd1234 profile=hotfix window=2026-05-03T01:00/02:00 notes="fix rounding" --preview
```
Maya: Preview prints expanded flags and a reversible manifest-id.
release-bot: I can implement preview + expansion. Example expansion: 
```
service=payments ref=sha:abcd1234 profile=hotfix(canary=5,preflight=smoke,auto-rollback=30m) window=2026-05-03T01:00/02:00 pin=false notes="fix rounding"
manifest_id=mf_20260503_0001
```
ops-bot: When preflight is present I will post a checklist and wait for two approvals unless `--auto-approve` is provided. If `--preview` only posts the checklist without blocking.
Sam: Add `--checkpoint` to snapshot DB migration state and return a checkpoint id (uploaded to S3). CLI prints `checkpoint=ckpt_20260503_01`.
Lina: Add `--escape` alias for fast rollback: `run-deploy --escape service=payments reason="incident"` does a 2-step confirm and promotes previous manifest.
Jorge: Also add `deployx template gen --service payments --profile hotfix --window ...` to output a canonical one-line snippet for runbooks. Keep profiles in `infra/deploy-profiles.yaml` so teams can add local profiles.
Maya: UX idea: `--notes-edit` opens a tiny modal (title, summary, rollback-steps) and attaches the note to the manifest. Saves copy-paste.
release-bot: Security: pin=true will require `pin-reason` for enterprise; expansion will fail if validation fails. I will also annotate the manifest with who expanded it.
Sam: Implementation split: I'll do CLI shim + preview endpoint.
Lina: I'll prototype the server-side expansion + lint.
Jorge: I'll write the compliance check for pin justification.
Maya: Great. I'll open a small RFC and a PoC runbook snippet. :rocket:
